subject: Excel
name: Import and delimiters
description: Bring a text file into Excel correctly: delimiter, text qualifier, data types and regional date/number settings.

subject: Excel
name: Spot and fix data problems
description: Find missing, invalid, duplicated or inconsistently formatted values and make them analysable.

subject: Excel
name: Filter and sort
description: Narrow a table to the rows that matter and order them.

subject: Excel
name: Conditional counting
description: Count rows that meet one or more conditions (COUNTIFS, distinct counts).

subject: Excel
name: Conditional totals and averages
description: Sum or average a column for a subset of rows (SUMIFS, AVERAGEIFS).

subject: Excel
name: Summarise with a PivotTable
description: Group by one or two fields and rank the groups.

subject: Excel
name: Date arithmetic
description: Work with dates and times: durations, lead times, year and month parts.

subject: Excel
name: Extract text from codes
description: Pull fields out of a combined code with LEFT, MID, RIGHT, FIND or Flash Fill.

subject: Excel
name: Join tables with lookups
description: Bring fields from one table into another with XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, including composite keys.

subject: SQL
name: SELECT with WHERE
description: Return chosen columns for rows that meet a condition.

subject: SQL
name: ORDER BY and LIMIT
description: Sort results and keep the top rows.

subject: SQL
name: Aggregate functions
description: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN and MAX over a set of rows.

subject: SQL
name: Pattern matching
description: Match text with LIKE and wildcards, or lists with IN.

subject: SQL
name: GROUP BY and HAVING
description: Aggregate per group and filter the groups.

subject: SQL
name: JOIN tables
description: Combine related tables on their keys.

subject: SQL
name: Subqueries
description: Use the result of one query inside another.

subject: SQL
name: Calculated columns
description: Derive new columns with arithmetic, CASE, text and date functions.

subject: Regression
name: Make a prediction
description: Plug values into the fitted equation.

subject: Regression
name: Interpret a coefficient
description: Say what a one-unit change means, holding the rest constant.

subject: Regression
name: Judge significance
description: Use the p-value to say whether an effect is distinguishable from zero.

subject: Regression
name: Interpret a 0/1 variable
description: Read a dummy coefficient as a difference between two groups.

subject: Regression
name: Interpret an interaction
description: Explain how one variable changes the effect of another.

subject: Regression
name: Judge model fit
description: Use R-squared and sample size to say how far to trust the model.
